name: SCP Foundation: Secure. Contain. Protect.
description: Adds SCP Foundation content: a database covering every SCP number from 001 to 9999, playable SCPs (173, 096, 049, 106, 682, 939, 999, 914, 294, 500 and more), keycards and doors, SCP-106's pocket dimension, and 99 generated world structures. Based on the SCP Wiki (scp-wiki.wikidot.com), licensed CC BY-SA 3.0.
